_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Waxaad ciyaaraysaa Klondike Solitaire. Ujeedadu waa inaad guudisid dhammaan kaararka ugu foundation piles.

Qawaaniinta Ciyaarta:
- Kooxdaha foundation (F1-F4): Dhis kor ugu Ace ilaa King suuqa
- Kooxdaha tableau (T1-T7): Dhis hoos ugu midabka isbeddelka (guduud ku guduud, madow ku madow)
- Stock: Kaararka sawirka ugu waste pile
- Waste (W): Kaararka sare ee ugu ciyaarta

Amarada:
- 'draw' - Kaararka sawirka ugu stock ilaa waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Guudisid kaararka ugu kooxda
  Tusaalooyin: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count sidoo kale waa 'all', oo ay ku doonaysa inay guudiso dhammaan kaararka muuqa.
- 'forfeit' - Ciyaarta dhamaan si degdeg ah oo ku qulqul score hadda
- Magacyada kooxdaha: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundations), T1-T7 (tableau)

Waxaad fulin kartaa falka badan oo amarada kuwa komma-ku-jarjaran:
  Tusaale: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Kings kaliya ayaa la saari karaa kooxdaha tableau faaruur.
Falku wuxuu fulinayaa si tartiib ah - haddii mid ka mid ah fashilo, falka soo socda waa la tirtiray.
Isticmaal 'forfeit' haddii aad u maleyso in ciyaarta ay tahay adag in la guuleysto.

format_error.no_brackets: Qaabka ficilku waa mid aan sax ahayn.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Formatka awooddaa waa khaldan. Gacma-qaboob xidhkeedu ']' waa laga waayay
format_error.move_needs_args: Amarada 'move' waxay u baahan tahay asal iyo u socota. Isticmaal: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: Tirada waa inay tahay taban ama 'all'
format_error.count_invalid: Tirada waa khaldan. Isticmaal tirada ama 'all'
format_error.unknown_command: Amarada '{cmd}' aan la aqoon. Isticmaal 'draw', 'move <source> <destination> [count]', ama 'forfeit'

move_result.invalid_pile: Magaca xidhka oo aan sax ahayn. Isticmaal W, F1-F4, ama T1-T7
